Keep background quiet and uncluttered, no buildings or legible signs, face dominates. Cohesive cream/turquoise/burgundy/gold palette from vintage casino posters but contemporary human subject. Entire hair/head and shoulders framed with generous margin for circular profile cropping; clearly readable at small size. Square 1024x1024. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, UI, heavy borders, crowns, masks, playing cards in hands, weapons or mascot characters.

images.concept: Abstract modern geometric spade with retro casino background
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE square abstract SuperAdmin profile avatar for a premium poker app. Strictly NONFIGURATIVE: no human, face, head, eyes, body, animal, mascot or character. Central modern sculptural geometric spade symbol made of elegant interlocking brushed antique-gold planes, with a small luminous turquoise diamond-shaped core and restrained burgundy inset details. A sophisticated visual metaphor for the system architect: precise symmetry, intelligent layered geometry, commanding but minimal. The spade floats as a compact three-dimensional art object with subtle depth and refined soft shadows, not a flat generic clipart icon. Strong instantly recognizable silhouette at 48px. Background contrasts modern geometry with vintage 1950s Las Vegas: warm aged cream paper grain, muted turquoise circular disc, a few very restrained burgundy and gold midcentury starburst accents near edges. Premium editorial artwork, subtle screenprint grain, warm cinematic highlights, rich burgundy/cream/turquoise/antique-gold palette. Central symbol fully inside central 65% of square with generous clean space for circular avatar cropping. Polished, creative, minimal. No crown, shields, padlocks, literal circuitry, letters, numbers, text, role labels, logos, watermark, outer border or UI. Square 1024x1024.
